title: The versioned corrective-action registry
description: The reviewed catalog of corrective behavior actions clozn ships in the core product (agent_roadmap/08-reversible-behavior-fixes.md). Built by clozn.behavior.registry.build_registry() from the EXISTING prompt-policy preset vocabulary (clozn.replay.corrective.CORRECTION_PRESETS) and control-vector dial vocabulary (clozn.behavior.steering.axes.AXES) -- never a hand-maintained duplicate of either. Each action lists every one of the four backend types (prompt_policy, control_vector, sampling_policy, unsupported) it was actually evaluated against, in preference order; a backend this exact model/build cannot honestly qualify is listed with type 'unsupported' and a reason, never silently omitted -- a reader always sees the full vocabulary evaluated, never guesses at what wasn't tried.

version.description: Registry content version, independent of schema_version -- bumped when the action list or a recipe changes.

id.description: Stable action id -- reuses the existing clozn.replay.corrective.CORRECTION_PRESETS key, never a parallel identifier.

conflicts.description: Other action ids this action cannot be combined with. Empty until a real conflicting pair exists.

qualification.description: The KIND of qualification this backend claims -- 'generic' (always available), 'model_build_exact' (only trustworthy once calibrated for the exact loaded model), or 'none'.

qualified.description: Live-checked against the currently loaded model when a steer object was supplied to build_registry(); omitted entirely (never guessed) when no live model was available to check.
